ux.text:
UX principles
• One app: mail + calendar + appointments share one JMAP account (Mail, Calendars, Contacts)
• Ctrl K command bar for everything: jump, act, search
• Invites render as RSVP cards; accepted events appear instantly in the agenda rail
• Appointment types → public booking link; free/busy from the calendar, confirmation by email
• Keyboard first on web (j/k, e, /, c, g c for calendar)
• Swipe: right = archive, left = snooze
• Dark only, one accent; tweak it per tenant (whitelabel)

driveUx.text:
Drive principles
• Same blob store as mail: an attachment is saved once and appears in Drive under “From email”
• Big attachments go out as a Drive link automatically
• Share = people or link, with expiry, password and view-only; access shows up in Activity
• Versions kept on every save; restore in one click
• Desktop sync client + WebDAV for any OS; offline folders on mobile
• Search reads PDF, Office and image text (OCR) in the same index as mail

needed.text:
What a sovereign suite needs
• Self-hosted, single binary or Helm; works air-gapped; no US cloud calls
• Customer-held keys (HSM/KMS), E2EE for chat + calls, encryption at rest
• Federation between orgs (Matrix for chat, SMTP for mail) with allow-lists
• Classification labels (Public…Secret) enforced on share/forward
• SSO (SAML/OIDC, eID, smart cards), MFA, SCIM provisioning
• Immutable audit log, eDiscovery, legal hold, retention policies
• Certifications: ISO 27001, SecNumCloud / BSI C5, NIS2, GDPR DPIA
• Open source + reproducible builds + SBOM + signed releases
• Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA / EN 301 549), many languages
• Migration from M365 / Google Workspace; Office docs editing

spacesUx.text:
Spaces
• A space = community: text channels + always-on rooms you drop into (no meeting link)
• Public, invite-only or org-only; join from Discover or a link
• Rooms: voice, video, screen-share streams, stage mode for town halls
• Roles + permissions per channel; slow mode, moderation queue
• Same identity, files and search as mail/chat
• Gov use: citizen help desks, inter-agency task forces, training rooms

loginTitle.text: Sign-in · QR from phone to workstation

loginUx.text:
QR sign-in
• Workstation shows a one-time QR (expires in 60 s, rotates)
• Phone app scans it; user picks the matching number (stops QR phishing)
• Phone confirms with Face ID / fingerprint; its device key signs the request (passkey-style, FIDO CTAP hybrid)
• Phone must be enrolled + compliant; workstation must be org-managed
• Shows place, device and time before approval
• Fallbacks: smart card / eID, security key, admin one-time code
• Walk away = lock (phone Bluetooth proximity, optional)
• Every sign-in goes to the audit log

navUx.text:
Navigation
• Web: left rail with 6 pinned apps (user can reorder/replace) + All apps grid + notifications + me
• The app you’re in shows under the pins when it isn’t pinned
• All apps grid also opens with Ctrl K → type app name
• Mobile: Mail · Chat · Calendar · Files · More; More holds every other app, pinned ones first
• Product name: Ortus; tenants rebrand (whitelabel)

osTitle.text: Ortus OS · Linux desktop, sign-in, device management

osUx.text:
Ortus OS stack
• Base: Fedora/CentOS bootc image; read-only /usr, atomic updates, rollback
• Desktop: fork of COSMIC (Rust, Smithay compositor, iced UI); GPU accel via Mesa / NVIDIA open driver, Vulkan, VA-API
• Greeter: own Rust greeter on greetd; QR phone sign-in via libwebauthn hybrid + custom PAM; smart card, FIDO2 key fallback
• Boot: own Secure Boot keys, signed UKI, LUKS2 unlocked by TPM2 + PIN, fs-verity
• MDM: fleetd/osquery + Ortus agent; enrol by QR; policies = image + config; TPM attestation gates sign-in; wipe by key revoke
• Sovereign: own mirror + registry, offline installer, SBOM, no telemetry

osLook.text:
Ortus OS UI rules
• No global app menus (COSMIC has none; Wayland protocol not standard yet) — menus stay in windows; top bar = app name + status
• Two layouts set by IT: Modern (top bar + dock) and Classic (bottom taskbar) for Windows users
• Shortcuts shown as Ctrl / Super, never ⌘; keyboard layout always visible
• Own window controls (glyphs, Ortus colours); GTK/Qt themes so Firefox, LibreOffice match
• Classification label per window, not per desktop
• Mic/camera/screen-share indicator in top bar; system prompts striped + mirrored on phone
• Glass falls back to solid on weak GPUs, VMs, remote desktop; always a scrim under text
• Dock magnification optional
• Ortus apps = same web UI in a native Rust shell; one token set for web + OS
• Screen reader: fix AccessKit gaps in libcosmic (text fields) and contribute upstream
